## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      1 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 4 авг. 2026 г. - 4 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Fadi Mujahid_, 4 авг. 2026 г., 3/5: "The app is very good at what it does and I purchased the premium app. However, the app keeps Google Play Service up all the time which results in battery drainage, which is very frustrating. Unlike other apps which might use Google services to check on the purchase, this app checks with this service on each click. Very unprofessional"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      2 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 18 сент. 2026 г. - 27 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Ed Nafziger_, 27 сент. 2026 г., 3/5: "I take about 10 vitamins 7 times a day. This app is very slow and tedious to add multiple reminders to the same habit. You have to add one at a time. Unfortunately, that makes using this app terrible for me. The "Tally Tracker" app does it right. There is no way to duplicate habits. The calendar row at the top can be scrolled into the future which doesn't make any sense to me."
            2. _Mohsen_, 18 сент. 2026 г., 5/5: "I used this app for almost 2 years, it has always been great. I don't remember if I ever encountered a bug or problem. The only reason I had to switch to a different app was that HabitNow does not provide an easy way to sync between devices. I remember I had to spend long durations to think about writing/managing tasks and habits and I'd rather do long tasks with a laptop with a proper desk and posture. Spending long durations on HabitNow on my phone always led to bad posture and neck pain."
<!--/ir-theme-->
